newsitem.title: ECUADOR: False bomb threat in Bucaram's TV charity program.
newsitem.headline: False bomb threat in Bucaram's TV charity program.

text.p: A bomb threat was phoned in on Sunday to a marathon TV festival in which Ecuadoran President Abdala Bucaram, taking part as a crooner, aims to raise funds for poor children, but no explosive was found, police said.

A telephone operator in charge of pledges received an anonymous call saying a bomb was planted in the TV studios in the coastal city of Guayaquil, but policemen with dogs searched the area to no avail, police said.
A Reuter photographer said police tried to make the search go unnoticed using plainclothsmen.
Bucaram has said he would sing in the 14-hour programme in case anyone came up with a million dollar gift for children.
